designBase.use: reuse its public API, journal, crash hooks, security, task invariants and human-impact contract except where this V2 packet explicitly amends them
designBase.statusNote: the V1 execution authorization remains superseded; only its immutable detailed design clauses are incorporated by this active V2 packet

writeLease.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=false; sort_keys=true; separators=(',',':'); SHA-256

forbiddenWrites: live runtime, bin or Scheduled Tasks

publicContract.constructor: InstallCutoverController(runtime_root, task_adapter, pythonw_path, process_adapter=None, security_adapter=None, owner_adapter=None, boundary_hook=None)
publicContract.stage: stage(manifest, source_root, installed_root, authority, observed_at) -> INSTALL_STAGE_RESULT_V1
publicContract.errors: PrivilegeDenied remains typed; all other contract failures raise InstallControlError with stable reason and no secret echo

authorityAmendment.validation: both owners exact, exact ordered schemas, canonical inner hashes and outer authority hash, sourceSha256=current launcher bytes, installedSha256=planned launcher bytes and taskActionSha256=canonical manifest action hash; validate before filesystem, pointer or Task mutation
authorityAmendment.installedPreflight: an empty installed root is stageable; an existing launcher is accepted only if its hash equals owner installedSha256, otherwise fail before any mutation
authorityAmendment.ownerGapDecision: existing runtime lifecycle and ops installer already produce the four required receipts; do not edit either owner script in S5B

ownerRecoveryAmendment.journal: seal both owner receipt hashes and both exact preimageSha256 values into INSTALL_CUTOVER_JOURNAL_V1 before candidate registration
ownerRecoveryAmendment.adapterRule: if owner_adapter is provided, rollback disables the new Task first, then calls restore('install_news_grasp_ops', ops preimage), then restore('launcher_runtime_lifecycle', runtime preimage); durable phase advancement makes a denial/crash retry idempotent
ownerRecoveryAmendment.noAdapterRule: when owner_adapter is absent, retain sealed owner preimages but perform the original Task/filesystem rollback contract without inventing an external owner call
ownerRecoveryAmendment.forbidden: self-reseal caller receipt, reconstruct a machine receipt, restore any owner while the new Task is enabled, repeat a completed restore

durableAndTaskContract.write: canonical UTF-8 JSON, atomic temp write, flush/fsync, os.replace and parent directory flush; exact schema/type/path/hash validation on every resume
durableAndTaskContract.stage: copy only source_root/launcher.pyw to installed_root/launcher.pyw, exact bytes/hash, optional hidden canary, register canonical candidate disabled exactly once, converge old-only and never cut over
durableAndTaskContract.cutover: disable old before enable new; dual-enabled count stays zero at every mutation; Pull/Inventory remain disabled and are never deleted
durableAndTaskContract.rollback: disable new before owner restores, restore exact old Task definition and enable old; crash/retry converges old-only

securityAndHumanImpact.security: reject traversal, absolute escape, reparse, source identity swap, source/install/hash/action drift, insecure ACL, untrusted signer, unknown/missing nested key, secret-looking content/control bytes/shell metacharacters before mutation; never echo secret text
securityAndHumanImpact.process: only injected process_adapter may launch the installed canary, one ordered argv call, shell=false, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, UTF-8, includeChildTree=true, noFocusTheft/noAutoOpen/noUserMonitoring=true; never shared-process kill
securityAndHumanImpact.outside: do not resolve or mutate outside authorized runtime/source/installed roots
securityAndHumanImpact.external: no network, external model, UAC, Task Scheduler or installed-machine mutation in unit implementation

verification.s5a: rerun the sealed corrected nine S5A nodes with the existing valid binding; expect 9 passed

commitPolicy.message: feat: implement S5 install cutover plane

causalRetry: one implementation attempt and one causal retry only; return immediately on an unresolved failure without editing tests or owner scripts
delivery: one production file hash/bytes, commit, exact verification exits, clean status and contrary evidence
stopPolicy: return to Sol after S5B; do not start S6 or mutate live installation
